statements: Future conceptual flow is application available -> INSTALLATION_NOT_INITIALIZED -> explicit offline init -> SECURITY_MASTER_NOT_INITIALIZED -> explicit SM initialization/update -> READY. READY means setup/identity readiness, not market freshness, route activation or execution permission. Current NOT_INITIALIZED is SM state; A2 must expose installation readiness separately while preserving existing-client SM meaning and L1 fresh uninitialized service/diagnostics without acquisition. Missing metadata cannot silently adopt old checkout state. Current runtime codes are unchanged.
compatibility_mapping: A2 integration required; preserve old-client SM NOT_INITIALIZED interpretation
